_meta.contentStatus: AI-drafted by the team with Claude. NOT checked by a native speaker. Key words were spot-checked against public references (see 'references'). Items marked check: 'unverified' could not be confirmed. No native-speaker check is planned.
_meta.source: Teammate's Self-Paced Learning Module and Question Bank (Beginner), with review fixes applied

fieldGuide.items: Words or phrases shown on the P04 Learn card. 'check' is 'ok' or 'unverified' ('unverified' = could not be confirmed in a published reference). There is no native-speaker check.
fieldGuide.audio: Native recordings only, ONE short clip per word or phrase (items[].audio) and ONE per letter (letters[].audio: the example word only, not the letter name). No audio for example sentences, dialogue lines, reading lines, terms or pattern examples: they are text only. Slow audio = the same clip at 0.75x.
fieldGuide.image: Path inside assets/, or null for phrases without a picture.
fieldGuide.scored: false = not counted in the pass mark (speaking, open_answer).
fieldGuide.answer: Index of the correct option (starts at 0). For build_sentence, the tiles in correct order.
fieldGuide.accepted: All accepted typed answers. The app ignores capital letters, spaces at the ends and . , ! ? before comparing.
fieldGuide.letters: Only in lessons with kind='letters' (Letters & Sounds screen). One card per letter.
fieldGuide.objectives: The 'In this lesson' list on Lesson Detail.
fieldGuide.icon / coverImage: Lesson row icon and Lesson Detail banner. Names match the Figma 'IMG /' layers.
fieldGuide.answerAudio: Played on the 'Not quite' sheet. null = hide the audio button.
fieldGuide.direction: type_answer only: 'fil_to_hil' (shown as 'Type this in Hiligaynon') or 'hil_to_fil'.
fieldGuide.wordBank: dictation only, optional tiles under the answer field.
fieldGuide.hint / maxChars: open_answer only. modelAnswer is shown on the 'Sample answer' sheet after Submit.
fieldGuide.parts: A lesson is a list of parts shown in order. The segmented progress bar has one segment per part. After the last part: Lesson complete, then the quiz.
fieldGuide.*text*: Words between asterisks are Hiligaynon (or Filipino) examples. Show them in italic violet.
fieldGuide.quick_check: Practice only, not scored. Right answer gives settings.xp.quickCheck XP. Shows 'explain' after answering.
fieldGuide.dialogue / reading lines: Text only (no audio). Tap a line to show or hide the Filipino meaning.
fieldGuide.template: Every part and question has a template ID (P01-P10, Q01-Q10). Look it up in 'templates' to find the Figma frame and the Flutter widget.
fieldGuide.icon (parts): Material Symbols Rounded icon name (same family as the V6 icon sheet).
fieldGuide.highlight: Pattern slots only: true on the one link word (ka, sang, sa, ang, ni, nga).
fieldGuide.hilColumns: Tables only: which columns hold Hiligaynon. Those cells are italic violet; the rest are plain.
fieldGuide.terms[].note: A short English note shown under the word with the label NOTE (not WHEN).
fieldGuide.alt: Another way to say the word in Hiligaynon (shown as 'Also said: …'). Never the Filipino meaning.
fieldGuide.unit: Intermediate only. {number, title}. The Learn list shows a header 'Unit N · title' before the first lesson of each unit.
fieldGuide.dialogue lines[].audio: Only on dialogues used for listening. One clip per line.
fieldGuide.listening (dialogue): true = hide the Hiligaynon text until the learner has played the audio once (or taps 'Show text').
fieldGuide.terms[].example: Optional example under a term: {hil, fil}. fil may be null.
fieldGuide.pattern.sentence: The full sentence the slots build (shown under the slots, above 'fil').
fieldGuide.open_answer.audio / transcript: Optional. Play button above the answer box; transcript is shown on the Sample answer sheet.
fieldGuide.icon / coverImage null: Pictures not made yet: show the placeholder thumbnail (Figma) and the firefly banner.
fieldGuide.image null (culture_note): Show firefly_reading until the picture exists.
fieldGuide.listening.audioText: Hiligaynon words of the clip. Shown in place of the play button when the clip is missing.
fieldGuide.role_play turns[].quote: Optional. A quoted line shown under the speaker's bubble (e.g. what another person said).
fieldGuide.role_play turns[].fil / choices[].fil: Advanced lessons give the Filipino inline; null = show none.
fieldGuide.role_play choices[].note: Optional small label on a choice, e.g. 'Filipino, to your friend'.
fieldGuide.reading.text: Optional intro line above a reading.
fieldGuide.dialogue lines[].audio (Advanced): Listening dialogues use audio/aNN/aNN_pNN_01.m4a … one clip per line.

read_answer: passagePart (id of a reading or dialogue part in the same lesson)
spot_mistake: tiles[] (sentence split on spaces; punctuation stays on its tile)
fix (shown on the fix chip and in F02; may be two words)
passage_set: passagePart (reading or dialogue part in the same lesson)

letters: title (shows the letters list, Lesson 1 only)
role_play: turns[]: speaker, hil, fil, cue (optional), fast (optional), choices[]: hil, fil (null = hide), correct, hint
verb_forms: roots[]: root, fil, forms[3], doerForms[3] (optional), example{hil,fil}
idiom_cards: cards[]: id, hil, literal, means, tone, careful, sayTo, warning (null = none), example{hil[], fil[]} (1–2 lines each, a dash per speaker), audio
register_pairs: situations[]: title, left{hil, fil|null, note?}, right{hil, fil}, changes[]

_meta.audioPolicy: Native recordings only, ONE short clip per word or phrase (items[].audio) and ONE per letter (letters[].audio: the example word only, not the letter name). No audio for example sentences, dialogue lines, reading lines, terms or pattern examples: they are text only. Slow audio = the same clip at 0.75x.

settings.unlockRule: needs='complete': unlocks when the lesson in 'after' is finished. needs='passQuiz': unlocks when that lesson's quiz is passed. Intermediate/Advanced unlock after the level before is finished.
settings.scoring: Score = correct scored questions / scored questions. 'scored': false questions (speaking, open_answer) are practice only and are shown as 'Practice' in Quiz review.

shuffle.note: Shuffle at runtime. 'answer' is the index in the JSON order; track where it lands after shuffling.

avatars.note: SVG files in assets/images/avatars/. Ana (and "You", the learner) is on the right; every other speaker is on the left.

uiLanguages.note: Only the app's own words (menus, buttons, labels, messages) follow this setting. Lesson content in lessons.json does not change: Hiligaynon stays Hiligaynon, meanings stay Filipino, and lesson explanations stay as written.

pronunciationFeedback.note: Q09 pronunciation similarity feedback (practice only: no score, no XP). Shown only when enabled is true and both thresholds are set; lower score = closer. veryClose/almost come from the team's test recordings. A recording counts as heard when its loudest 25 ms reaches minLevelDb (dBFS) and the sound lasts at least minSpeechMs; otherwise 'Couldn't hear'. No native clip = 'Comparison coming soon'.

S01.name: Learn (lesson list)
fields: levels[].lessons[]: title, partsCount, estMinutes, icon, unlock

S02.name: Lesson Detail
variants: In progress: Continue lesson + progress card
Completed: chip "Completed · Quiz X/Y", Review lesson + Retake the quiz, no progress card

S04.name: Quiz result
S04.figmaFrame: Quiz result · Perpekto / Maayo gid / Keep practicing

P02.name: Table
fields: hilColumns[] (indexes of Hiligaynon columns: italic violet)

P03.name: Pattern
fields: slots[]: label, hil, highlight (one slot: the link word)
variants: 3 or 4 slots; the highlighted slot is violet with a glow, the others alternate citrus and lagoon

P04.name: Words (learn cards)
fields: itemIds[] -> items[]: hil, fil, alt, audio, image, example
variants: No image: image is null → firefly_reading (Example box still shows if example exists)
No example: example is null → hide the Example box

P05.name: Letters & sounds
fields: letters[]: letter, name, soundHint, audio, example

P06.name: Quick check
variants: Uses Feedback sheet F01/F02, no timer, +settings.xp.quickCheck

P11.name: Role-play
P11.figmaFrame: P11 · Part · Role-play · Choose / Right choice / Not quite / Done
fields: turns[]: speaker, hil, fil, cue (optional), fast (optional), choices[]: hil, fil (null = hide), correct, hint
variants: Choose: show the speaker's bubble and the choices; Next disabled
Right choice: add the learner's reply bubble (Ana avatar, right side), then the next turn
Not quite: show the hint, the learner tries again (no XP lost)
Done: whole chat + tip; Next enabled
P11.notes: Text only, no audio. A turn with no choices is the closing line. 'cue' is a short instruction shown above the choices. 'fast': show a small 'talking fast' label on that bubble. Instruction line under the setting: 'Choose your reply.'

P12.name: Verb forms
P12.figmaFrame: P12 · Part · Verb forms · kaon / inom
fields: roots[]: root, fil, forms[3], doerForms[3] (optional), example{hil,fil}
variants: One root at a time; root chips switch the table
doerForms present: show a second row 'Who does it' above 'What it happens to'

P13.name: Idiom cards
P13.figmaFrame: P13 · Part · Idiom card · Default / Careful (+ long card)
fields: cards[]: id, hil, literal, means, tone, careful, sayTo, warning (null = none), example{hil[], fil[]} (1–2 lines each, a dash per speaker), audio
variants: Careful: tone chip in Warning colour + warning line
Counter 'n / N'; Back/Next between cards like P04

P14.name: Formal vs casual
P14.figmaFrame: P14 · Part · Formal vs casual (+ paging, wrong-on-purpose, long text)
fields: situations[]: title, left{hil, fil|null, note?}, right{hil, fil}, changes[]
variants: left.note present (leftWrongOnPurpose): grey card with ✗, note in small text instead of Filipino

Q11.name: Read & answer
Q11.figmaFrame: Q11 · Quiz · Read & answer (+ Listening variants)
fields: passagePart (id of a reading or dialogue part in the same lesson)
variants: read: show the passage lines (Hiligaynon only) above the question
listen: show a play button that plays the passage's line clips in order; no text until answered
Q11.notes: No timer: reading or listening to the passage takes time.

Q12.name: Spot the mistake
Q12.figmaFrame: Q12 · Quiz · Spot the mistake · Default / Word selected / Correct / Wrong (+ wrap)
fields: tiles[] (sentence split on spaces; punctuation stays on its tile)
fix (shown on the fix chip and in F02; may be two words)
Q12.notes: No timer. Correct = tapping tiles[wrongIndex]. Tiles wrap to more rows when needed.

Q13.name: Passage set
Q13.figmaFrame: Q13 · Quiz · Passage set · Reading / Listening (+ dialogue passage)
fields: passagePart (reading or dialogue part in the same lesson)
Q13.notes: Each sub-question is its own scored question in the quiz (3 per set, back to back). Header keeps the quiz position (e.g. 11 / 15) and shows 'Question n of N' as a small label. Passage collapses to 'Show story' after the first question. Dialogue passages show 'Speaker: line'. Listen mode plays the part's line clips in order; 'Show transcript' after answering. No timer.
